title: Amending a standing order

steps.title: Open the amendment request from the inbox
Verify the account mandate and signatory
Enter the new amount and payment day
Submit the amendment for dual approval
Confirm the change to the customer by secure message

decisions: If the account is joint and both holders must sign, get the second holder's consent before amending; a sole signatory can instruct alone.
If the instruction came by phone, call the customer back on the number held on file (never the number they called from) before acting.
If the new amount is above M$2,500, submit the amendment for a second approver; under the threshold, save it directly.
warnings: You cannot approve your own amendment; the system blocks it.
If the next payment is less than two working days away, the payment file is already built and the change only applies the following month, so tell the customer or they will pay the old amount.
openQuestions: Whether a payment-date-only change under the threshold needs dual approval: Theo will confirm with Operational Risk.
